summary: A mixed legal and business day with key Supreme Court insurance directives, regulatory shifts affecting retail endorsements, and notable capital market movements. Attention needed on F&B compliance implications for your sector.

bullets.text: Supreme Court orders States to establish SITs investigating fraudulent motor accident insurance claims.
F&B regulatory crackdown prompts celebrity endorsement pullbacks; watch compliance requirements for retail marketing.
SoftBank divests 2.6% Lenskart stake for Rs 2,888 crore; significant retail sector investor movement.
Consumer giants' forex earnings surge despite global headwinds; export momentum strengthens.
Piyush Goyal promises BIS certification relief for high-tech firms; regulatory compliance easing coming.
